Title: SQL-injection style input is treated as text
Steps:
1. Open Log in modal
2. Enter the injection payload in both fields
3. Click 'Log in'
Expected Result: Alert 'User does not exist.'; no authentication bypass, no server error.

Title: Script injection in username is not executed
Steps:
1. Sign up with the payload as username (if accepted)
2. Log in with it
3. Observe navbar
Expected Result: No script executes; payload is rendered as plain text in 'Welcome …'.

Title: Repeated wrong passwords (brute force)
Preconditions: A registered user exists (auto-provisioned via API by the framework)
Expected Result: Account lockout / throttling / CAPTCHA after N failures (security expectation). Record actual behaviour.

Title: Receipt masks the card number
Steps:
1. Place an order
2. Inspect 'Card Number' on the receipt
Expected Result: Only the last 4 digits are shown (e.g. **** 1111).
